title: Google Appeals Landmark Ruling Declaring It a Monopolist in Search
meta_title: Google Appeals Monopolist Ruling in Search

spot: Google has asked a federal appeals court to reverse a judge's ruling that it had violated antitrust laws and a requirement to share some data with rivals, in a landmark case that declared the company a monopolist in search.
content_html:
Background of the Case

Google has been accused of violating antitrust laws by engaging in anti-competitive practices in the search market.

The Ruling

A judge's ruling declared Google a monopolist in search and required the company to share some data with rivals.

Google's Appeal

Google has asked a federal appeals court to reverse the judge's ruling, arguing that it did not violate antitrust laws.

Potential Impact

The outcome of the appeal could have significant implications for the search market and Google's dominance in the industry.
